issues.issue: Did the enforcement officer err in refusing to defer removal pending the in-Canada spousal sponsorship application?
issues.applicant_position: Pending in-Canada spousal application and family circumstances should have led the officer to defer removal.
issues.result_quote: The enforcement officer did not act unreasonably in refusing to defer the removal of the Applicant on this basis.

issues.issue: Did the officer have to consider the best interests of the Canadian-born children before refusing deferral?
issues.applicant_position: Psychological and child-related circumstances were not adequately taken into account in refusing deferral.
issues.result_quote: an enforcement officer is not required to undertake a substantive review of the children’s best interests before executing a removal order.

issues.issue: Did the officer adequately take into account the spouse's psychological state?
issues.applicant_position: Spouse's psychological ailments were not adequately taken into account when refusing deferral.
issues.result_quote: These were findings which fall within a range of possible, acceptable outcomes which are defensible in respect of the facts and law
